# What will Turo actually pay you for this trip?

> Free Turo host payout calculator. Turo's host share now depends on your earnings plan (Peace of Mind, Balanced, More Earnings) AND how far ahead the guest books — this tool models the whole matrix, compares all three plans and all four booking windows for the same trip, and projects a monthly estimate.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
